name: Wall Calf Stretch

instructions.description: Face a wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height.
Step one leg back with the heel down and the back knee straight.
Bend the front knee and lean forward until you feel a stretch in the back calf.
Hold, then switch sides after returning to the start.

performanceMetrics.notes: Keep the rear heel grounded throughout the stretch.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Slightly bend the back knee to bias the deeper calf muscle.

commentsNotes: Point the back foot straight ahead.
Do not bounce into the stretch.
